title: Engineering Head
description:
Head of Engineering Trading & Real-Time Systems Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on, high-impact Engineering Leader to own and drive our entire engineering function. This role demands a rare combination of deep technical expertise, architectural vision, and execution excellence. You will be responsible for building secure, scalable, low-latency, real-time systems in a stock broking / trading domain, while leading teams and solving mission-critical production challenges. This is not a managerial role—we need a builder, debugger, and decision-maker. What You Will Do 1. Engineering Leadership & Ownership Own end-to-end engineering delivery across backend and frontend systems. Lead, mentor, and scale multiple engineering teams. Establish strong engineering culture, processes, and accountability. Drive high standards in: Code quality System design Architecture governance 2. Architecture & System Design Design highly scalable, fault-tolerant microservices architectures. Ensure systems are: Highly available Low latency (real-time capable) Extensible and future-ready Standardize architecture across legacy and modern systems. Drive architectural decisions across the organization. 3. Security-First Engineering Enforce secure-by-design principles. Implement: Authentication & authorization frameworks Data protection & encryption strategies Ensure compliance with: OWASP standards API security best practices 4. Crisis Management & RCA Take ownership during production outages and incidents. Perform fast and accurate Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Drive: Immediate resolution Long-term architectural fixes Build resilient systems to minimize downtime impact. 5. AI-First Engineering Culture Drive adoption of AI across engineering workflows: Faster development Intelligent debugging Automation Enable teams to leverage tools like: AI copilots Code assistants Improve productivity and engineering velocity. 6. Distributed & Event-Driven Systems Architect systems using: Kafka / Event Streaming Asynchronous communication patterns Ensure: Data consistency Fault tolerance Real-time processing reliability 7. DevOps & Reliability Oversee: CI/CD pipelines Containerization (Docker) Observability (logs, metrics, tracing) Ensure: High uptime System resilience Performance optimization Core Technical Expertise Backend & Architecture Strong hands-on expertise in Core Java + Spring Boot (preferred) or equivalent. Deep expertise in: Microservices Architecture Distributed Systems Design Performance Optimization Solution Architecture Databases Strong experience with: PostgreSQL / MySQL MongoDB / NoSQL Expertise in: Data Modeling Query Optimization High-volume Data Handling Messaging & Streaming Must-Have Kafka Strong Understanding Of Event-Driven Architecture Real-Time Data Pipelines Security Strong knowledge of: JWT, OAuth2 API Security Encryption Practices Experience building secure systems at scale. DevOps Hands-on with: Docker CI/CD Pipelines Monitoring Tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) AI Enablement Practical experience with AI coding tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) and proven ability to drive AI adoption across engineering teams. Leadership Expectations (Critical) Extreme ownership mindset Security-first thinking in every decision AI-first approach to productivity Strong decision-making under pressure Hands-on leader who writes code and performs deep reviews Fast problem solver and crisis handler High discipline, punctuality, and accountability Strong product and business understanding Proven ability to mentor and grow engineering teams Ideal Candidate Profile 8+ years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership. Experience leading backend and frontend teams for high-scale, real-time, low-latency platforms. Background in trading, stock broking, or fintech ecosystems is highly preferred. Proven track record of managing production-critical environments and handling outages effectively. Ability to balance Speed, Stability, and Security. Strong cross-functional leadership across diverse technology stacks. Success Metrics System uptime and reliability Incident response and RCA efficiency Scalability and architecture quality Engineering productivity and code quality AI adoption across teams Reduction in production issues Bonus Qualifications Experience with Kubernetes Exposure to distributed tracing systems Background in low-latency trading platforms Knowledge of building High-Frequency Trading (HFT) systems Experience 8+ Years Location Mumbai

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
Company: PeopleTree Knowledge Services
Location: APAC
Employment Type: Full-Time
Working Days: Monday to Friday
Working Hours: 1:00 PM to 11:00 PM 
 Job Overview 
 PeopleTree Knowledge Services is looking for a Backend Software Engineer to own and evolve high-stakes, distributed financial systems that keep advertiser billing accounts accurate, compliant, and in sync across multiple datastores and external platforms. This is a deeply hands-on backend engineering role focused on correctness-critical financial systems, distributed architecture, event-driven systems, and production-grade software development. 
 Must-Have Skills & Experience 
 6+ years of hands-on backend engineering with Java and Spring Boot 3, building production microservices; mid-to-senior level with demonstrated ownership of production services in a distributed-systems environment. Experience with GraphQL, either building APIs with Netflix DGS or consuming them via the Apollo Java/Kotlin client. Hands-on experience with event-driven, distributed systems using AWS SQS or Apache Kafka, or RabbitMQ. Strong JPA/Hibernate and Spring Data JPA experience with MySQL/Aurora, including transactional design and optimistic locking. Proficiency writing JUnit 5 unit tests with Mockito and integration tests against live environments. Experience with Gradle multi-module builds. Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Datadog for metrics and monitors. Responsible use of AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality and correctness. 
 Demonstrated Prior Experience 
 Building or maintaining a production Spring Boot service that consumes events from SQS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ. Designing idempotent event handlers. Writing JPA entities and managing schema migrations against a production MySQL/Aurora database. Integrating with an external REST or SDK-based third-party platform. Setting up or working with Datadog monitors as deploy quality gates in a CI/CD pipeline. 
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
 Prior experience in the Billing or Payments domain. Experience with DynamoDB (AWS SDK v2) and/or MongoDB (Spring Data) in a multi-store architecture. Netflix DGS. 
 Scope of Work 
 We are looking for a backend engineer to own and evolve these high-stakes, distributed financial systems, which keep advertiser billing accounts accurate, compliant, and in sync across multiple datastores and external platforms. The role is deeply hands-on backend engineering applied to correctness-critical financial systems. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain backend Java/Spring Boot services, contributing feature development, bug fixes, and reliability improvements across BAM services. Solve problems around transactional consistency, event-driven correctness, notification reliability at scale, and safe multi-entity migrations for advertisers globally. Keep advertiser billing accounts accurate, compliant, and in sync across multiple datastores (MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB) and external platforms (Zuora). Deliver production-ready feature work and bug fixes via GitLab CI, with unit and integration test coverage meeting Jacoco gates. Strengthen system reliability through improved observability, resilience patterns, and safe canary and production deploys gated by Datadog monitors. 
 Working Schedule Monday to Friday, 1:00 PM to 11:00 PM

Key Skills: Microservices,Backend Development,Spring Boot 3,Java,Event-Driven Architecture,Kafka,GitLab CI/CD,Distributed Systems

title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
